name: GroundControlInspectionRegister
tagline: Ground inspections, hazard map, risk matrix, TARP restrictions and remediation in one plug-and-play Power Apps component.
description: A complete ground control app for underground and open-pit mines: log shift and geotechnical inspections, rate hazards on a 5×5 matrix, combine risk with prism and extensometer rates into TARP levels that drive area restrictions, and run remediation through to independent verification – in Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: TARP from risk rating and displacement rate
Remediation board with drag and drop
Default due dates by rating and overdue tracking
Bulk assign, void and CSV export
Demo mode with fictional mine data
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control)
